description: Client-side script for managing dynamic data tables, modals, and CRUD operations in an admin panel of a transportation management system.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches data from API and populates the table with pagination.

methods.name: makeTable
methods.description: Builds HTML table with data, including modals for editing and viewing images.

methods.name: makeModals
methods.description: Creates modals for updating, creating, and deleting records.

methods.name: updateRecord
methods.description: Sends PUT request to update a record.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Sends DELETE request to remove a record.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Sends POST request to create a new record.

methods.name: getRowId
methods.description: Retrieves record ID from modal input.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Handles password change via API call.
